interpretation: Positive gain is held-block choice log-score improvement over observed cue/motion/history covariates. Current cue is conditioned on even in precue analysis, so these are retrospective conditional comparisons. Trials are shared across windows and all windows use the same outer split. Rat means weight sessions equally; no independent-unit or significance claim. Sorted-count zeros are observations of the deposited event list, not verified biological silence. Region evidence does not verify same-neuron continuity across source epochs; no cross-epoch lag is used. Content reinstatement, causal direction, learning-induced coupling and a positive-definite brain metric remain unestablished.
